packageRules.description: Rust toolchain stays on its own: a toolchain bump has to land before any crate update that needs its new MSRV, so it cannot be folded into the general stream.

mokosh-types is the single-crate shared-DTO dependency pinned by `scripts/check-types-pin.sh`; its bumps are governed by MAPPS-1161's weekly drift guard and must stay reviewable on their own, not folded into the general stream.

getrandom is declared only to enable the wasm backend for the version the tree compiles (0.4, via rand_core 0.10). A major bump moves the feature off that copy and breaks the wasm32 build. Lift this when rand_core 0.10 leaves the tree.
